summary: Baidu filed a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: Form 6-K share buyback disclosure) covering daily repurchases of Class A ordinary shares (HKEX 09888) for cancellation. Eight trading days from September 7 to 16, 2026 saw 545,000 to 565,850 shares bought daily at HKD 88.35-92.38, roughly 0.025% of issued shares per day and about 4.44 million shares total. Issued shares held at 2,209,541,178; board authorization and listing-rule compliance confirmed, no advisor named. Watch buyback pace and cash deployment against ADS pricing.
